summary: Otovo ASA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sale and installation of solar panels and related home energy products in Norway, Sweden, Poland, Italy, Germany, Switzerland, Austria, France, the Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, Portugal, and the United Kingdom. It operates through three segments: Newbuild, Recurring Services, and Field Services. The company offers solar, battery, generator, and electricity plans; and various services, including system inspection, pro cleaning, critter guard, generator tune-up, and removal and reinstall, as well as maintenance, grid, electricity, home energy products renting, and subscription services. It also provides Endurance, an AI-built software and online sales platform that automates workflows across intake, diagnostics, dispatch, procurement, billing, and customer support. The company serves residential and commercial customers. Otovo ASA was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway.
